name: Colonial Pipeline
description: Major refined-products pipeline system transporting gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other products from the U.S. Gulf Coast to markets in the Southeast and East Coast.
notes: Operator reports the system transports more than 100 million gallons, or about 2.5 million barrels, of fuel per day.

name: Tennessee Gas Pipeline
description: Interstate natural gas transmission pipeline system serving U.S. Gulf Coast, Appalachian, Midwestern and Northeastern markets.
source_name: Kinder Morgan / Tennessee Gas Pipeline financial statements
notes: Source reports approximately 11,800 miles of pipeline with design capacity of approximately 12.2 Bcf per day.

name: Keystone Pipeline
description: Cross-border crude oil pipeline system transporting Canadian crude oil into the U.S. Midwest and Gulf Coast pipeline network.
notes: Reuters describes Keystone as South Bow's signature asset and reports 622,000 bpd on the Canada-to-Nebraska segment.

name: Grand Coulee Dam
description: Large hydroelectric generating complex on the Columbia River in Washington State.
notes: Source reports generating capacity of more than 6,809 MW.

name: Palo Verde Generating Station
description: Nuclear power generating station west of Phoenix, Arizona, and one of the largest power generators in the United States.
notes: Source reports capacity of 4,200 MW and identifies APS as owner and operator.

name: Three Gorges Hydropower Station
description: Large hydroelectric generating station on the Yangtze River in China.
notes: Source reports total installed capacity of 22.5 GW across 34 hydro-generating units.

name: Hornsea One Offshore Wind Farm
description: Offshore wind farm in the North Sea serving the United Kingdom power market.
notes: Operator reports combined total capacity of 1.2 GW from 174 turbines.

name: Jebel Ali Power and Desalination Complex
description: Large natural gas-fired power and desalination complex in Dubai.
notes: Source reports 9,547 MW of power generation capacity and describes it as the largest single-site natural gas power facility.

name: Jamnagar Refinery
description: Large integrated refining complex at Jamnagar, Gujarat, India.
notes: Operator reports 1.4 MMBPD crude processing capacity and describes Jamnagar as the world's largest and most complex single-site refinery.

name: Motiva Port Arthur Refinery
description: Large refinery in Port Arthur, Texas, serving U.S. Gulf Coast petroleum product markets.
notes: Operator reports total throughput of 730,000 bpd and identifies the site as North America's largest refinery.

name: Marathon Galveston Bay Refinery
description: Large refinery in Texas City, Texas, integrated with nearby Gulf Coast refining and logistics assets.
notes: Operator reports crude oil refining capacity of 631,000 barrels per calendar day.

name: Ghawar Field
description: Large onshore conventional oil field in Saudi Arabia.
notes: Capacity reflects reported maximum sustainable capacity from Saudi Aramco disclosures; current production volume was not verified.

name: Troll Field
description: Major Norwegian North Sea gas field supplying European gas markets.
notes: Source verifies the field's location and strategic role in Norwegian gas production; nameplate production capacity was not verified.

name: Kashagan Field
description: Offshore oil and gas field in the North Caspian Sea, part of Kazakhstan's North Caspian Project.
notes: Source reports crude oil production capacity of approximately 430,000 bpd for the North Caspian Project.

name: Sabine Pass Liquefaction
description: LNG liquefaction and export facility in Cameron Parish, Louisiana.
notes: Operator reports six fully operational liquefaction trains with aggregate nominal production capacity of approximately 30 mtpa.

name: Gorgon LNG
description: Three-train LNG liquefaction and domestic gas project on Barrow Island, Western Australia.
notes: Operator reports a three-train LNG facility with 15.6 mtpa capacity and a domestic gas plant.

name: Kollsnes Gas Processing Plant
description: Large Norwegian gas processing plant handling gas from the Troll field and other North Sea assets.
notes: Source reports Kollsnes is managed by Gassco and can process 158 million cubic meters of natural gas per day.

name: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve
description: Federally owned crude oil storage system using underground salt caverns on the U.S. Gulf Coast.
notes: Source reports authorized storage capacity of 714 million barrels.

name: Cushing Crude Oil Storage Hub
description: Major crude oil storage and trading hub in Cushing, Oklahoma.
notes: Source reports 76.6 million barrels of storage capacity at Cushing. Operator is null because Cushing is a multi-operator hub rather than a single asset operator.

name: Rough Gas Storage Facility
description: Large offshore natural gas storage facility serving the United Kingdom market.
notes: Source identifies Centrica Energy Storage+ as owner and operator of Rough; reported storage capacity is 54 bcf.

name: South Hook LNG Terminal
description: LNG import and regasification terminal at Milford Haven, Wales.
operator_name: South Hook LNG Terminal Company Ltd
notes: Source reports process capacity of 19.5 mtpa and annual gas send-out capability of 21 bcm.

name: Enbridge Ingleside Energy Center
description: Major crude oil marine export terminal and storage facility at Ingleside, Texas.
notes: Source reports current storage capacity of 20 million barrels across Enbridge's Ingleside export terminal assets.

name: Nederland Terminal
description: Large marine terminal and storage facility in Nederland, Texas, handling crude oil, NGLs, feedstocks and petrochemicals.
notes: Source reports approximately 33 million barrels of total storage capacity in 84 aboveground storage tanks.

name: Portland Aluminium Smelter
description: Large aluminium smelter in Portland, Victoria, and a major industrial electricity consumer.
notes: Capacity is aluminium production capacity, used as an industrial-load proxy. Source reports total capacity of 358,000 metric tons per year.

name: Intel Ocotillo Campus
description: Large semiconductor manufacturing campus in Chandler, Arizona, and a major industrial power load.
source_name: National Institute of Standards and Technology draft environmental assessment
notes: Capacity is load-serving capacity identified for the facility, not semiconductor production output.
